Evan (partnerships): Quick heads-up — we're planning a small but breaking SDK change in v2.1.0 that removes the legacy x-redwood-auth header in favour of standard Authorization Bearer tokens. Target deploy is next Wed 2026-03-25. Need to align on partner notifications and marketplace listings.
Priya (platform): Thanks Evan. Do we have a compatibility matrix yet? We should call out which marketplace images and partner SDKs need immediate updates. :thinking_face: 
Nina (eng-sdk): working on it. initial matrix attached below. will also add migration snippets to the SDK changelog.
Carlos (partner-eng): tagging a few partners who embed our SDK in their installers — they'll need lead time. @Marketplace Bot can you queue a marketplace status check for any images referencing sdk:v1.* ?
Marketplace Bot: Scheduled scan queued. Results in ~15m. Will post list in this thread when done. :gear:
Evan (partnerships): high-level ask: (1) list of partner integrations that will break if we drop x-redwood-auth, (2) migration script examples, (3) suggested rollback/fallback policy for partners that can't upgrade by date. Keep replies short — we'll compile a partner-facing email.
Priya (platform): fallback idea: runtime accept both headers for 30 days behind a flag, then disable in a toggleable rollout. Ops OK with that?
Nina (eng-sdk): ops concurs but prefers a 14-day overlap to reduce drift. I'll add a feature flag gate: 
```
FEATURE_FLAGS={"accept_legacy_auth": true}
# will flip to false on 2026-04-08 in controlled regions
```
Nina (eng-sdk): migration snippet for partners (JS):
```
// v1.x (legacy)
const headers = { 'x-redwood-auth': OLD_KEY };
// v2.1.0 (new)
const headers = { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}` };
```
Carlos (partner-eng): sample partner email draft: "We will be deprecating x-redwood-auth on 2026-04-08. Please migrate to Authorization: Bearer tokens by then. If you need extra time, reply with your CI/CD cutoff date." Should we offer assisted migration calls? :phone:
Evan (partnerships): yes, offer 2x 30-min office hours next week and targeted ops support for top 5 partners. Nina — can you produce a short rollback playbook if the flag flip causes regressions?
Nina (eng-sdk): will do. minimal rollback steps: (1) re-enable accept_legacy_auth flag, (2) redeploy previous sdk-compatible image, (3) open a hotfix channel. I'll write it up as a 1-page runbook.
Marketplace Bot: Scan complete. Found 12 marketplace images referencing sdk:v1.*, 3 of which are published by partners (acme-integrations, globe-systems, dataforge). Posting the list to #partners-ops.
Priya (platform): action items: 
- Nina: publish SDK migration doc + 1-page rollback runbook (due Tue EOD)
- Evan: partner email + schedule office hours (due Mon AM)
- Carlos: contact top 5 partner leads and log responses (ongoing)
- Ops: prepare feature flag toggle plan and monitoring alerts
Evan (partnerships): perfect. One more thing — for marketplace listings, we should add a compatibility badge and note whether images auto-update to sdk v2.*. That will reduce surprise breakages. Can someone own that?
Carlos (partner-eng): I'll own the marketplace badge work. Will coordinate with Product to define the badge copy.
Evan (partnerships): thanks everyone. Please drop a short ack here when you start your item so we can track. :thumbsup:
Priya (platform): ACK — starting ops coordination now.
Nina (eng-sdk): ACK — will push draft doc by Tue EOD.
Carlos (partner-eng): ACK — starting partner outreach now.
Evan (partnerships): I'll draft the partner email and share for review later today.
Marketplace Bot: Reminder scheduled: office hours invites will be sent after Evan posts times.
Carlos (partner-eng): small note — partner globe-systems requested a longer deprecation window, they have a legal review that takes ~3 weeks. We should be ready to offer an exception and map scope.
Evan (partnerships): noted. we'll triage exceptions on a case-by-case basis. thanks all.
